lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white line segments with irregular spacing; density is highest in the mid-torso and increases in width between segments toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal apex of the 4th line from the posterior; a secondary bifurcation is noted on the 7th line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first and second posterior lines are abbreviated, terminating mid-thigh. Several anterior lines exhibit fading or discontinuity before reaching the ventral belly line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the lower haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: The tongue is protruding from the right side of the mouth; distinctive white chevron on the bridge of the snout and a prominent white spot located approximately 20 pixels below the right eye.
